role: Independent DOI-provenance reviewer of the EFC corpus; separates CITES from BUILDS_ON.
independence_caveat: Same model family as the other five reviewers; agreement is reading consistency, not independent validation.

findings.excerpt: 31942821 CITES 31876324, 31941465, 31878760, 31942800. 31941465 declares BUILDS_ON 31878760 and 31878334. 31941543 declares BUILDS_ON 31876324, 31878760, 31941465. 31943361 CITES many upstream DOIs but its index.json has related_packages: [].
findings.falsified_by: Package metadata or source files explicitly marking a different dependency graph, or removal of those DOI entries.

findings.excerpt: index.json description/core_equations states Gamma = Gamma0*rho/(rho+rho_crit), while key_result states Gamma ~ rho^(3/2)/(rho+rho_crit) 'Scenario B'. Source code states rho^(3/2).
findings.falsified_by: A canonical versioned source or PDF resolving the discrepancy in favor of one exponent, with index.json and code agreeing.

findings.excerpt: D_eff ~ sqrt(rho/rho_crit); Gamma = Gamma0*y/(1+y), y=sqrt(rho/rho_crit); key_result labels 'Scenario B+'.
findings.falsified_by: A canonical derivation showing D_eff ~ rho^1 or Gamma ~ rho/(rho+rho_crit), or an explicit declaration that Scenario B+ is non-normative.

findings.excerpt: mu_be_form: mu(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1). The gravitational-regime theorem is E ~ sqrt(g), so the BE exponent in g is 1/2. KC1 contrasts and rejects the linear-g exponent.
findings.falsified_by: A revised canonical grid-action derivation adopting exp(g/a0), or data excluding the sqrt(g) exponent while retaining the action.

findings.excerpt: Target/derived form is mu(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1); chain E ~ sqrt(g) -> BE -> mu(g); FC3 fixes excitation-energy power alpha=1/2.
findings.falsified_by: A first-principles lattice derivation yielding E ~ g^alpha with alpha != 1/2, or a canonical correction to exp(g/a0).

findings.excerpt: mu_be and SR5 specify mu(g)=1/(exp(sqrt(g/a0))-1). The EFT states this BE form is postulated, not derived from the classical action.
findings.falsified_by: A valid derivation of the BE response from the classical action, or a canonical replacement of the sqrt(g) response.

findings.excerpt: mu_be explicitly mu_BE(g)=1/(exp(g/a0)-1), linear exponent 1. Incompatible at face value with the sqrt(g/a0) exponent in 31878334, 31878760, 31941465.
findings.falsified_by: A corrected index.json changing mu_BE to exp(sqrt(g/a0)), or an explicit regime mapping proving the two exponents are not competing normative forms.

findings.excerpt: Action component entropy_production gives Gamma = gamma0*(rho/rho_crit)/(1+rho/rho_crit), numerator exponent 1. Does not label Scenario A/B/B+ and does not cite 31942821 or 31942800.
findings.falsified_by: A package-level declaration tying this action to the 3/2 or 1/2 Gamma bridge.

findings.excerpt: Relativistic action reproduced; LCDM limit K(rho)->inf, T(a)->0, xi>>1; no normative Gamma equation, Scenario label, or BE exponent declared.
findings.falsified_by: A package index, source file, or PDF section explicitly declaring the adopted Gamma form and BE exponent.

findings.excerpt: 31942821 source says 'Companion: Density of States (31942800) - upgrades to Scenario B+'; data records companion=31942800. Supersession declared as upgrade/companion, not full replacement.
findings.falsified_by: A canonical declaration that 31942800 is merely parallel/independent, or that 31942821 is fully superseded and no longer normative.

findings.excerpt: 31941465 and 31941543 use connections.builds_on. 31943361 CITES the same upstream set but declares no related_packages. CITES is bibliographic, not BUILDS_ON.
findings.falsified_by: Explicit builds_on/related_packages declarations in 31943361 or equivalent dependency statements in its source/PDF.

findings.excerpt: doi-map lists both dirs. citations.bib files diverge (different keys/titles); neither contains the DOI.
findings.falsified_by: Byte-identical citations.bib files or a corrected DOI map removing one directory.

findings.excerpt: doi-map lists both dirs. EFC-R-SPARC/citations.bib is a stub without DOI; EFC-R-SPARC-Regime-Validity/citations.bib contains the DOI plus SPARC literature.
findings.falsified_by: Consolidation or byte-identical bibliographies after DOI-map correction.

findings.excerpt: Both dirs have distinct one-entry citations.bib stubs; neither contains the DOI.
findings.falsified_by: Directory consolidation or identical canonical bibliography content.

findings.excerpt: doi-map lists four duplicate DOI pairs. Nested dirs have multi-entry bibliographies; parallel hyphenated dirs have single minimal @misc entries. Divergent.
findings.falsified_by: A canonical consolidation manifest proving one directory is archival-only.

verdict: The corpus contains explicit CITES edges and a smaller set of explicit BUILDS_ON edges; citations alone do not establish theoretical dependency. The clearest declared direction is 31878334 -> 31878760 -> 31941543, with 31941465 building on 31878760 and 31878334, while 31942800 is a companion upgrade to 31942821. Gamma is not normatively consistent across packages: 31942821/source uses Scenario B (3/2) but its index core equation records exponent 1; 31942800 uses B+ (1/2); 31876324 uses exponent 1; 31941543 uses BE exponent 1. Supersession is declared only as the 31942821 -> 31942800 companion upgrade to Scenario B+; full replacement is not declared. Seven duplicate groups exist, all with divergent citations.bib.
falsification: This review would be overturned by authoritative versioned PDFs or package manifests that resolve the Gamma exponent and BE exponent per DOI, explicitly define the complete dependency graph, declare 31942800 a full replacement or non-replacement of 31942821, and identify one canonical directory plus authoritative citations.bib for each duplicate DOI.
